senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; apocope of שרשר , v. שָׁרָר) [chain, knot,] root.—Pl. שֳׁרָשִׁים, שֳׁרָשִׁין; constr. שָׁרְשֵׁי, שׁוֹרְשֵׁי.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:4">B. Bath. V, 4</cite> <he>העולה … ומן הש׳ וכ׳</he> that which shoots forth out of the trunk, or out of the roots, belongs to the landowner (v. <cite ref="C00571"><he>גֶּזַע</he></cite>), expl.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 82a">ib. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>כל שאינו … זהו מן הש׳</he> that which does not see the light of day (when it shoots forth) is out of the roots’.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:5:4">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:3:7">Y. Taan. I, 64ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ חטה</he> the roots of wheat; <he>ש׳ תאנה</he> of fig-trees.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 7:17">Tosef. Shebi. VII, 17</cite>; ‘<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 1:4">Uktsin I, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00356"><he>קוֹלָס</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:17">Ab. III, 17</cite> <he>וְשֳׁרָשָׁיו מרובין</he> whose roots are many; a. fr.
